Tagalog.answer: Kadalasan, mabuti para sa iyo ang mga tuntunin. Nariyan ang mga ito upang protektahan ka at ilayo ka sa kapahamakan.

English.question: What does the Bible teach regarding obedience to our parents?
English.answer: The Bible teaches us that we should honor and obey our parents. This means that you should be respectful when talking to or about your parents and furthermore, you should obey their rules.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang itinuturo ng Biblia tungkol sa pagsunod sa ating mga magulang?
Tagalog.answer: Itinuturo ng Biblia na dapat nating igalang at sundin ang ating mga magulang. Ibig sabihin, dapat tayong magpakita ng paggalang kapag nakikipag-usap sa kanila o tungkol sa kanila, at sumunod sa kanilang mga tuntunin.

English.question: How do you think your parents feel when you are disobedient?
English.answer: Because your parents love you, it makes them very sad when you are disobedient and they have to punish you. No good parent enjoys punishing a child.

Tagalog.question: Ano sa palagay mo ang nadarama ng iyong mga magulang kapag hindi ka sumusunod?
Tagalog.answer: Dahil mahal ka nila, labis silang nalulungkot kapag sumusuway ka at kailangan ka nilang disiplinahin. Walang mabuting magulang na natutuwa sa pagpaparusa sa anak.

English.question: Why is it important for you to be punished when you disobey your parents’ rules?
English.answer: God has appointed parents to teach their children about obedience — to our parents and more importantly, to obey God. This is a parent’s most important duty: To raise godly children on behalf of God, our Heavenly Dad and to teach children about His love and grace. By punishing you for disobedience, teaches you that disobedience always has rather unpleasant consequences so that next time, you’ll hopefully think twice before doing what you know you shouldn’t do.

Tagalog.question: Bakit mahalagang disiplinahin ka kapag nilabag mo ang mga tuntunin ng iyong mga magulang?
Tagalog.answer: Itinalaga ng Diyos ang mga magulang upang turuan ang kanilang mga anak na sumunod—una sa mga magulang at, higit sa lahat, sa Diyos. Pinakamahalagang tungkulin ng magulang ang magpalaki ng mga anak na may takot sa Diyos sa ngalan ng ating Ama sa Langit at ituro sa kanila ang Kaniyang pag-ibig at biyaya. Sa pagdidisiplina sa iyo, natututuhan mong may hindi kanais-nais na bunga ang pagsuway, upang sa susunod ay mag-isip ka muna bago gawin ang alam mong mali.

English.question: What does it mean when God says He gave us ‘freedom of choice’?
English.answer: GOD created us with the freedom of choice, because true love must always give you the freedom to choose for yourself. This means that we can choose whether we want to serve, love and obey God, or not. BUT REMEMBER, choices always have consequences.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng pagbibigay ng Diyos sa atin ng “kalayaang pumili”?
Tagalog.answer: Nilikha tayo ng DIYOS na may kalayaang pumili, sapagkat ang tunay na pag-ibig ay laging nagbibigay ng kalayaang magpasya. Maaari nating piliing paglingkuran, ibigin, at sundin ang Diyos o hindi. NGUNIT TANDAAN: ang bawat pagpili ay may kahihinatnan.

English.question: What is sin?
English.answer: Sin is anything we think, do, or say in violation of GOD’s Commands as clearly outlined in the Ten Commandments given to us in Exodus 20. This is God’s Law and this Law shows us what sin really is. Read 1 John 3:4 and Rom 7:7-8.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang kasalanan?
Tagalog.answer: Ang kasalanan ay anumang iniisip, ginagawa, o sinasabi natin na lumalabag sa mga Utos ng DIYOS na malinaw na nakasaad sa Sampung Utos sa Exodo 20. Ang kautusang ito ng Diyos ang nagpapakita sa atin kung ano ang kasalanan. Basahin ang 1 Juan 3:4 at Roma 7:7–8.

English.question: Can this Law cleanse us from our sin?
English.answer: So in reality, the Ten Commandments are like a mirror in which we can see where we became filthy because of sin. Water cannot wash away the stains caused by our sins, neither can simply staring into the mirror accomplish this. Only the blood of Jesus Christ, our Savior can cleanse us of our sins.

Tagalog.question: Maaari ba tayong linisin ng Kautusan mula sa kasalanan?
Tagalog.answer: Ang Sampung Utos ay parang salamin na nagpapakita kung saan tayo nadungisan ng kasalanan. Hindi mahuhugasan ng tubig ang mga batik ng ating kasalanan, at hindi rin ito mawawala sa pagtitig lamang sa salamin. Ang dugo lamang ni Jesu-Cristo na ating Tagapagligtas ang makapaglilinis sa atin mula sa kasalanan.

English.question: Why did God give us the Ten Commandments?
English.answer: As we’ve learnt in the very first question about rules, God gave us the Ten Commandments because He loves us very much and He wants to protect us from the negative and harmful consequences of disobedience.

Tagalog.question: Bakit ibinigay sa atin ng Diyos ang Sampung Utos?
Tagalog.answer: Gaya ng natutuhan natin sa unang tanong tungkol sa mga tuntunin, ibinigay sa atin ng Diyos ang Sampung Utos dahil mahal na mahal Niya tayo at nais Niya tayong protektahan sa masasakit na kahihinatnan ng pagsuway.

English.question: What about people that have never heard of the Commandments before?
English.answer: Deep inside our hearts and minds, we all know very well what is right and what is wrong, because we were created in the image of God and because the Holy Spirit constantly reminds us of this. It remains our choice whether we will listen to that Voice, or not.

Tagalog.question: Paano naman ang mga taong hindi pa nakarinig tungkol sa mga Utos?
Tagalog.answer: Sa kaibuturan ng ating puso at isip, alam nating lahat kung ano ang tama at mali dahil nilikha tayo ayon sa larawan ng Diyos at patuloy tayong pinapaalalahanan ng Banal na Espiritu. Nasa atin pa rin ang pagpili kung makikinig tayo sa Tinig na iyon o hindi.

English.question: What was the first rule that God gave to Adam and Eve?
English.answer: God told them not to eat from the ‘Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil’.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang unang tuntuning ibinigay ng Diyos kina Adan at Eva?
Tagalog.answer: Sinabi ng Diyos na huwag nilang kainin ang bunga ng “Punongkahoy ng Pagkakilala ng Mabuti at Masama.”

English.question: What would happen if they did eat the fruit from this tree?
English.answer: Because Adam and Eve were still 100% obedient to God at that point, there was no sin in the world and they knew absolutely nothing about evil. But if they would eat from the fruit of this tree, they would find out what evil and sin really was.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang mangyayari kung kakainin nila ang bunga ng punongkahoy na iyon?
Tagalog.answer: Dahil lubos pang sumusunod sina Adan at Eva sa Diyos noong panahong iyon, wala pang kasalanan sa mundo at wala silang alam tungkol sa kasamaan. Ngunit kung kakainin nila ang bunga ng punongkahoy, malalaman nila kung ano talaga ang kasamaan at kasalanan.

English.question: What was God’s warning to Adam and Eve about the consequences of this?
English.answer: God warned them and gave them a very good reason why they should not eat the fruit from that tree, because if they did, they would surely die! God wanted to protect Adam and Eve from harm by teaching them to be obedient to Him. He did not want them to become acquainted with sorrow and evil, but the choice was in their hands.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang babala ng Diyos kina Adan at Eva tungkol sa kahihinatnan nito?
Tagalog.answer: Binalaan sila ng Diyos at binigyan ng magandang dahilan upang huwag kainin ang bunga: kung gagawin nila iyon, tiyak silang mamamatay! Nais ng Diyos na protektahan sina Adan at Eva sa pamamagitan ng pagtuturo ng pagsunod sa Kaniya. Hindi Niya nais na makilala nila ang kalungkutan at kasamaan, ngunit sila ang kailangang pumili.

English.question: Was the snake that tempted Eve just a snake?
English.answer: No, satan used the serpent as an instrument to talk to Eve. The devil or satan likes to use various instruments to stimulate our curiosity and to tempt us and eventually, to deceive us into disobeying God.

Tagalog.question: Ordinaryong ahas lamang ba ang ahas na tumukso kay Eva?
Tagalog.answer: Hindi. Ginamit ni Satanas ang ahas bilang kasangkapan upang makausap si Eva. Mahilig gumamit ang diyablo o si Satanas ng iba't ibang kasangkapan upang pukawin ang ating pag-uusisa, tuksuhin tayo, at sa huli ay linlangin tayo upang suwayin ang Diyos.

English.question: What was satan’s plan?
English.answer: Satan’s objective was to get Eve to doubt God’s trustworthiness by making her doubt what God had said. He also cunningly twisted what God actually commanded.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang plano ni Satanas?
Tagalog.answer: Layunin ni Satanas na pagdudahan ni Eva ang pagiging mapagkakatiwalaan ng Diyos sa pamamagitan ng pagdududa sa Kaniyang sinabi. Tusong binago rin niya ang tunay na iniutos ng Diyos.

English.question: Who told the first lie in the Bible and what was that lie?
English.answer: Satan told the first lie, which is why Jesus called him the father of lies (John 8:44). This lie had to do with the mortality of mankind. Satan actually told Eve that God lied to them and that they would not really die. To this very day, people still believe this lie — that when we die, we simply ‘live on’ and immediately go either to heaven, or to hell because they believe mankind has an immortal soul. But the Bible teaches very clearly that man is a mortal soul. He does not have a soul as though it is something separate; and that mankind is mortal. Only God is immortal (1Tim 3:13 and 16). Satan also lied about something else: When he said that Adam and Eve would become ‘like God’. He implied that they would become as powerful as God.

Tagalog.question: Sino ang unang nagsinungaling sa Biblia, at ano ang kasinungalingang iyon?
Tagalog.answer: Si Satanas ang unang nagsinungaling, kaya tinawag siya ni Jesus na ama ng kasinungalingan (Juan 8:44). Ang kasinungalingang ito ay tungkol sa pagiging mortal ng tao. Sinabi ni Satanas kay Eva na nagsisinungaling ang Diyos at hindi talaga sila mamamatay. Hanggang ngayon, ayon sa aralin, marami ang naniniwalang kapag namatay tayo ay nagpapatuloy tayong mabuhay at agad pumupunta sa langit o impiyerno dahil iniisip nilang may kaluluwang walang kamatayan ang tao. Ngunit itinuturo ng Biblia na ang tao ay isang mortal na kaluluwa at walang hiwalay na kaluluwang walang kamatayan. Ang Diyos lamang ang walang kamatayan (1 Timoteo 3:13 at 16, ayon sa sanggunian ng materyal). Nagsinungaling din si Satanas nang sabihin niyang magiging “katulad ng Diyos” sina Adan at Eva, na para bang magiging kapantay sila ng Diyos sa kapangyarihan.

English.question: What is the ‘unforgivable sin’ spoken of in the Bible?
English.answer: The longer we continue to do the wrong thing, the less it will bother us the next time because in this way, we become insensitive to sin; and if it gets to a point that it doesn’t bother us any more when we sin (that we don’t feel guilty any more) then we won’t even want to ask for God’s forgiveness. God cannot forgive us unless we listen to the conviction of the Holy Spirit, confess our sin and ask for His forgiveness. We must always remain sensitive to sin and never become comfortable with it! It must always bother us when we do something wrong because the price Jesus paid for our sins, was terribly high. There is no sin that God is unwilling to forgive the truly repentant sinner

Tagalog.question: Ano ang “kasalanang hindi mapapatawad” na binabanggit sa Biblia?
Tagalog.answer: Habang patuloy tayong gumagawa ng mali, lalo tayong hindi nababagabag sa susunod, sapagkat nagiging manhid tayo sa kasalanan. Kapag umabot sa puntong hindi na tayo nakokonsensiya, maaaring ayaw na nating humingi ng kapatawaran sa Diyos. Ayon sa aralin, hindi tayo mapapatawad kung hindi natin pakikinggan ang pag-uudyok ng Banal na Espiritu, ipagtatapat ang kasalanan, at hihingi ng kapatawaran. Dapat tayong manatiling sensitibo sa kasalanan at huwag kailanman masanay rito. Dapat tayong mabagabag kapag may nagawa tayong mali, sapagkat napakalaki ng halagang ibinayad ni Jesus para sa ating mga kasalanan. Walang kasalanang hindi handang patawarin ng Diyos sa taong tunay na nagsisisi.

English.question: How did Adam and Eve feel after they sinned against God?
English.answer: Adam and Eve immediately realized that they had done something wrong. They now had knowledge of sin and evil because they had been disobedient to God. Evil had now become a part of their lives. It changed them and it damaged their relationship with God. The character of innocence and righteousness they had, were tarnished and they realized that they were naked. They deeply regretted what they had done. They felt guilty and embarrassed about their disobedience. They now realized that it was not God who had lied to them, but satan, because they certainly did not feel so great after eating the fruit.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang nadama nina Adan at Eva matapos silang magkasala sa Diyos?
Tagalog.answer: Agad nilang napagtantong may nagawa silang mali. Dahil sumuway sila sa Diyos, nalaman nila ang kasalanan at kasamaan. Naging bahagi ng kanilang buhay ang kasamaan, binago sila nito, at sinira ang kanilang kaugnayan sa Diyos. Nadungisan ang kanilang dating kawalang-malay at katuwiran, at nakita nilang hubad sila. Labis nilang pinagsisihan ang kanilang ginawa. Nakaramdam sila ng pagkakasala at kahihiyan sa pagsuway. Nalaman nilang hindi ang Diyos ang nagsinungaling sa kanila kundi si Satanas, sapagkat hindi sila naging masaya matapos kainin ang bunga.

English.question: How do you feel after doing something wrong?
English.answer: Let the children explain themselves and compare to how Adam and Eve felt (regret, sadness, shame…)

Tagalog.question: Ano ang nadarama mo kapag may nagawa kang mali?
Tagalog.answer: Hayaang magpaliwanag ang mga bata at ihambing ang kanilang nadarama sa nadama nina Adan at Eva: pagsisisi, kalungkutan, kahihiyan, at iba pa.

English.question: Adam and Eve tried to hide from God after they sinned. In which way are humans still doing this today
English.answer: Just like Adam and Eve, we also try to hide behind ‘fig leaves’. We do it by either lying about it, or by trying to justify it, or by saying: “Oh well, it’s not that serious.” or ‘Everyone does it”

Tagalog.question: Sinubukan nina Adan at Eva na magtago sa Diyos matapos silang magkasala. Paano pa rin ginagawa iyon ng mga tao ngayon?
Tagalog.answer: Tulad nina Adan at Eva, sinusubukan din nating magtago sa likod ng “mga dahon ng igos.” Ginagawa natin ito sa pagsisinungaling, sa pagbibigay-katwiran sa ating ginawa, o sa pagsasabing “Hindi naman iyon ganoon kasama” o “Ginagawa naman iyon ng lahat.”

English.question: Why is it so dangerous to try and justify your wrongdoing (sin)?
English.answer: Because sin is sin and God says that all sin is equally serious because all sin eventually leads to eternal death. God wants to give us eternal life, not eternal death.

Tagalog.question: Bakit mapanganib ang pagbibigay-katwiran sa ating maling gawain o kasalanan?
Tagalog.answer: Sapagkat ang kasalanan ay kasalanan, at sinasabi ng Diyos na pare-parehong seryoso ang lahat ng kasalanan dahil sa huli ay humahantong ang kasalanan sa walang-hanggang kamatayan. Nais ng Diyos na bigyan tayo ng buhay na walang hanggan, hindi kamatayang walang hanggan.

English.question: What was Adam’s reaction when God asked him whether he ate fruit the tree?
English.answer: Instead of Adam admitting to his own guilt, he immediately first blamed GOD and then Eve.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang ginawa ni Adan nang tanungin siya ng Diyos kung kumain siya ng bunga ng punongkahoy?
Tagalog.answer: Sa halip na aminin ang kaniyang kasalanan, agad niyang sinisi muna ang DIYOS at pagkatapos ay si Eva.

English.question: What was Eve’s excuse?
English.answer: She blamed the serpent

Tagalog.question: Ano ang idinahilan ni Eva?
Tagalog.answer: Sinisi niya ang ahas.

English.question: Can we blame someone else when we choose to sin, even if they deceived us?
English.answer: No! We cannot blame anyone else and what’s more, GOD cannot forgive us unless we confess to what we have done wrong specifically and personally ask Him to forgive us. No one can do that on our behalf; certainly not a priest.

Tagalog.question: Maaari ba nating sisihin ang iba kapag pinili nating magkasala, kahit nalinlang nila tayo?
Tagalog.answer: Hindi! Hindi natin maaaring sisihin ang iba. Higit pa rito, ayon sa aralin, hindi tayo mapapatawad ng DIYOS kung hindi natin personal na ipagtatapat ang ating partikular na nagawang mali at hihingi ng kapatawaran sa Kaniya. Walang ibang makagagawa nito para sa atin, kahit pari.

English.question: Can we simply say: “I’m sorry Jesus” and do that wrong thing again?
English.answer: No. When we ask for forgiveness for something we have done wrong, we should try hard not to do it again. However, if we ask for forgiveness while already planning in our hearts to do it again, thinking that no one will know, then we are not sincerely sorry and God cannot forgive us.

Tagalog.question: Maaari ba tayong magsabi lamang ng “Patawarin Mo ako, Jesus” at pagkatapos ay ulitin ang mali?
Tagalog.answer: Hindi. Kapag humingi tayo ng kapatawaran sa isang maling nagawa, dapat tayong magsikap na huwag na itong ulitin. Ngunit kung humihingi tayo ng tawad habang balak na nating ulitin ito at iniisip na walang makaaalam, hindi tayo tunay na nagsisisi, at ayon sa aralin ay hindi tayo mapapatawad ng Diyos.

English.question: Does God know what we think?
English.answer: Oh yes because He is omniscient, which means, He knows everything! God always looks at what is in our hearts. We cannot hide anything from Him, not even our thoughts. Read 1 Sam 16:7.

Tagalog.question: Alam ba ng Diyos ang ating mga iniisip?
Tagalog.answer: Oo, sapagkat alam Niya ang lahat! Laging tinitingnan ng Diyos ang nilalaman ng ating puso. Wala tayong maitatago sa Kaniya, maging ang ating mga iniisip. Basahin ang 1 Samuel 16:7.

English.question: GOD warned that they would die if they ate from the fruit of the forbidden tree. But why? Was the tree and its fruit poisonous?
English.answer: No, there was nothing wrong with the tree or its fruit. Just like all the other things which God had created, the tree was ‘very good’. But God had forbidden Adam and Eve to eat of this specific tree as a test of their loyalty and obedience to Him.

Tagalog.question: Binalaan sila ng DIYOS na mamamatay sila kung kakainin nila ang ipinagbabawal na bunga. Bakit? Nakalalason ba ang punongkahoy at bunga nito?
Tagalog.answer: Hindi. Walang masama sa punongkahoy o sa bunga nito. Gaya ng lahat ng nilikha ng Diyos, “napakabuti” nito. Ngunit ipinagbawal ng Diyos na kainin nina Adan at Eva ang bunga ng partikular na punongkahoy bilang pagsubok sa kanilang katapatan at pagsunod sa Kaniya.

English.question: Why does God have to punish sin?
English.answer: Because God is 100% love, but also 100% righteous and holy, He must punish the sinner.

Tagalog.question: Bakit kailangang parusahan ng Diyos ang kasalanan?
Tagalog.answer: Sapagkat ang Diyos ay ganap na pag-ibig ngunit ganap ding matuwid at banal, kaya kailangang parusahan ang nagkasala.

English.question: Did God still love Adam and Eve after they sinned?
English.answer: Oh yes! Even though God was very sad about their wrong choice, He still loved them as much as before. God felt very sorry for them. It broke His heart to see their unhappiness. He was particularly sad because He knew what sad consequences sin would bring to them and also to all of their descendants right up to us today.

Tagalog.question: Mahal pa rin ba ng Diyos sina Adan at Eva matapos silang magkasala?
Tagalog.answer: Oo! Bagama't labis na nalungkot ang Diyos sa kanilang maling pagpili, mahal pa rin Niya sila gaya ng dati. Nahabag Siya sa kanila at nasaktan Siya sa kanilang kalungkutan. Lalo Siyang nalungkot dahil alam Niya ang masasamang kahihinatnang dadalhin ng kasalanan sa kanila at sa lahat ng kanilang magiging anak at inapo, hanggang sa ating panahon.

English.question: What ray of hope did God give to them?
English.answer: One of the Persons of the Godhead, the Son of God and the Creator of heaven and earth, Jesus Christ, declared Himself willing to pay the penalty for sin on behalf of mankind — even before Creation occurred. This meant that He would sacrifice His Own life in the place of sinners such as Adam and Eve (and you and me).

Tagalog.question: Anong sinag ng pag-asa ang ibinigay ng Diyos sa kanila?
Tagalog.answer: Si Jesu-Cristo, ang Anak ng Diyos, isa sa mga Persona ng pagka-Diyos at Manlilikha ng langit at lupa, ay kusang nagpahayag ng Kaniyang kahandaang bayaran ang parusa sa kasalanan para sa sangkatauhan—bago pa man ang Paglikha. Ibig sabihin, iaalay Niya ang sariling buhay kapalit ng mga makasalanan gaya nina Adan at Eva, at gaya mo at ko.

English.question: Why did God make clothes of skin for them to wear?
English.answer: God wanted to teach Adam and Eve about this Plan of Salvation and since God made clothes of skin, it meant that an innocent animal had to be slaughtered on their behalf; the first creature that ever died on earth. This was probably when they first learnt about sacrifice. In other words, because of sin, something had to die in their place as a type, or an example, of Christ, the true Sacrifice on their and our behalf.

Tagalog.question: Bakit gumawa ang Diyos ng mga damit na balat para sa kanila?
Tagalog.answer: Nais ng Diyos na ituro kina Adan at Eva ang Plano ng Kaligtasan. Dahil gumawa Siya ng mga damit mula sa balat, nangangahulugan ito na isang inosenteng hayop ang kailangang patayin para sa kanila—ang unang nilalang na namatay sa Daigdig, ayon sa materyal. Maaaring dito nila unang natutuhan ang tungkol sa paghahain. Dahil sa kasalanan, may kailangang mamatay bilang kahalili nila, bilang larawan o halimbawa ni Cristo, ang tunay na Sakripisyo para sa kanila at para sa atin.

English.question: Some people say that it was unfair and cruel of God to have his Son crucified, but is this true?
English.answer: It is very important to understand that the Son Himself voluntarily offered to lay down His life because He loves the Father and us with infinite love! Nobody commanded the Son to do so and the Son did not make any decision on His own, but always in accordance with His Father’s will. The Plan of Salvation was therefore determined in unison by the Godhead. When JESUS says that He lay down His life Himself, it simply emphasizes that HE was not forced to do so, but did so voluntarily out of love for us and for the Father. Read John 10:17-18.

Tagalog.question: Sinasabi ng ilan na hindi makatarungan at malupit na pinahintulutan ng Diyos na ipako sa krus ang Kaniyang Anak. Totoo ba ito?
Tagalog.answer: Mahalagang maunawaan na ang Anak mismo ay kusang nag-alok na ibigay ang Kaniyang buhay sapagkat walang hanggan ang pagmamahal Niya sa Ama at sa atin! Walang nag-utos sa Anak na gawin iyon. Hindi rin Siya nagpasya nang hiwalay sa Ama kundi laging ayon sa kalooban ng Ama. Kaya nagkaisa ang pagka-Diyos sa pagbuo ng Plano ng Kaligtasan. Nang sabihin ni JESUS na kusang ibinibigay Niya ang Kaniyang buhay, binigyang-diin Niyang walang pumilit sa Kaniya; ginawa Niya ito nang kusa dahil sa pagmamahal sa atin at sa Ama. Basahin ang Juan 10:17–18.

English.question: So what is this great hope that God had given to humanity here?
English.answer: HE promised that hope and forgiveness would be available to all of humanity through JESUS CHRIST.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang dakilang pag-asang ibinigay ng Diyos sa sangkatauhan?
Tagalog.answer: Ipinangako Niyang magkakaroon ng pag-asa at kapatawaran ang buong sangkatauhan sa pamamagitan ni JESU-CRISTO.

English.question: What is a prophecy?
English.answer: A prophecy is a revelation from God to humanity about things that will happen in future; and because some of those things have already taken place, we can look back into history to see how perfectly God’s prophecies have been fulfilled.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang propesiya?
Tagalog.answer: Ang propesiya ay pahayag ng Diyos sa sangkatauhan tungkol sa mga bagay na mangyayari sa hinaharap. Dahil ang ilan sa mga ito ay naganap na, maaari nating balikan ang kasaysayan upang makita kung paano natupad ang mga propesiya ng Diyos.

English.question: Genesis 3 contains a very important prophecy. What is it about?
English.answer: It explains how One of the descendants of the woman would one day bruise the serpent’s head and the serpent would bruise His heel.

Tagalog.question: May napakahalagang propesiya sa Genesis 3. Tungkol saan ito?
Tagalog.answer: Ipinapaliwanag nito na isang Inapo ng babae ang darating upang durugin ang ulo ng ahas, samantalang sasaktan naman ng ahas ang Kaniyang sakong.

English.question: What does it mean?
English.answer: This prophecy refers to the fact that Jesus Christ would come to earth to completely destroy satan and his work of deception. Jesus would die on the cross on our behalf and because He rose again after three days, He conquered the curse of sin, which is death, once and for all — forever! And so Jesus bruised the serpent’s head and the serpent represents satan.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin nito?
Tagalog.answer: Tumutukoy ang propesiyang ito sa pagdating ni Jesu-Cristo sa lupa upang lubusang wasakin si Satanas at ang kaniyang panlilinlang. Mamamatay si Jesus sa krus para sa atin, at dahil Siya ay muling nabuhay makalipas ang tatlong araw, nagtagumpay Siya sa sumpa ng kasalanan, ang kamatayan, minsan at magpakailanman! Kaya dinurog ni Jesus ang ulo ng ahas, at ang ahas ay sumasagisag kay Satanas.

English.question: What did God tell Eve specifically?
English.answer: That because of her sin, her pain and effort in child birth would be greatly increased.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang partikular na sinabi ng Diyos kay Eva?
Tagalog.answer: Dahil sa kaniyang kasalanan, lubhang darami ang sakit at hirap na mararanasan niya sa panganganak.

English.question: What did God tell Adam specifically?
English.answer: God told Adam that the earth was now cursed because of their sin and that it would yield thorns and thistles. These did not exist before the Fall. Where Adam’s work was an absolute pleasure to do in the past, it would now require a lot of effort. For the rest of their lives on earth, humanity would have to work very, very hard for the soil to yield their food.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang partikular na sinabi ng Diyos kay Adan?
Tagalog.answer: Sinabi ng Diyos kay Adan na isinumpa na ang lupa dahil sa kanilang kasalanan, kaya ito'y tutubuan ng mga tinik at dawag. Wala ang mga ito bago ang Pagkahulog. Ang dating kasiya-siyang paggawa ni Adan ay mangangailangan na ngayon ng napakalaking pagsisikap. Sa natitirang buhay ng mga tao, kailangan nilang magpagal upang makakuha ng pagkain mula sa lupa.

English.question: Can we still see the consequences of the Fall in nature today?
English.answer: Yes, we see it in a beautiful flower that wilts, falls to the ground, rots and dies. We see it in crops that fail, in droughts and in floods. We experience it when terrible storms and tsunamis devastate vast areas and we see it when we bite into a juicy mango just to find a worm inside that has already spoilt it. Read Rom 8:20-22

Tagalog.question: Nakikita pa rin ba natin ngayon sa kalikasan ang mga bunga ng Pagkahulog?
Tagalog.answer: Oo. Nakikita natin ito sa magandang bulaklak na nalalanta, nalalaglag, nabubulok, at namamatay; sa mga pananim na nasisira, tagtuyot, at baha; sa mga mapanirang bagyo at tsunami; at maging sa makatas na mangga na may uod sa loob na sumira na rito. Basahin ang Roma 8:20–22.

English.question: Why did God send Adam and Eve out of the Garden of Eden?
English.answer: There was another tree in the Garden of Eden that God mentioned specifically; and that was the ‘Tree of Life’. In Rev 22:1-2 & 14 we are told that the fruit of this tree will bring healing and that everyone who goes to heaven will eat of this fruit and live with God, forever. So if Adam and Eve still had access to this tree in the Garden of Eden; and if they had eaten the fruit in their sinful state, mankind would have become immortal and would have had to live in this sinful condition forever. This is why God sent them out of the Garden and commanded an angel to guard the access to Eden and therefore also to the ‘Tree of Life’.

Tagalog.question: Bakit pinalabas ng Diyos sina Adan at Eva sa Halamanan ng Eden?
Tagalog.answer: May isa pang punongkahoy sa Eden na partikular na binanggit ng Diyos: ang “Punongkahoy ng Buhay.” Sa Apocalipsis 22:1–2 at 14, sinasabi sa atin na ang bunga nito ay magdadala ng kagalingan at na ang mga pupunta sa langit ay kakain ng bunga nito at mabubuhay kasama ng Diyos magpakailanman. Kung patuloy na makakakain sina Adan at Eva mula sa punong iyon habang makasalanan sila, magiging walang kamatayan ang sangkatauhan at mabubuhay magpakailanman sa kalagayang makasalanan. Kaya pinalabas sila ng Diyos sa halamanan at inutusan ang isang anghel na bantayan ang daan patungong Eden at sa Punongkahoy ng Buhay.

English.question: What else do we learn from this?
English.answer: This proves once again, that mankind is mortal. We would only have been immortal if we had remained obedient and had unlimited access to the ‘Tree of Life’. Even though Adam eventually lived for 930 years, both Adam and Eve slowly began to die from that very moment when they chose to sin — just like us every day.

Tagalog.question: Ano pa ang natututuhan natin dito?
Tagalog.answer: Ipinakikita nitong mortal ang sangkatauhan. Magiging walang kamatayan lamang sana tayo kung nanatili tayong masunurin at palaging may daan sa Punongkahoy ng Buhay. Bagama't umabot sa 930 taon ang buhay ni Adan, nagsimula nang unti-unting mamatay sina Adan at Eva mula sa sandaling pinili nilang magkasala, gaya ng nangyayari sa atin araw-araw.

English.question: Why is there so much pain, suffering, disease, war and sadness in the world today? Is it
English.answer: God’s fault? God created Adam and Eve to be perfect, healthy and happy and with the ability to choose between obedience or disobedience to God; just like we too have to make that choice every day. When we make a choice, we have to accept the consequences of that choice as well. When Adam and Eve chose disobedience, the consequences was that sin, disease, suffering and death came into the world. This was certainly not how God intended life for mankind to be. Read Rom 5:12.

Tagalog.question: Bakit napakaraming sakit, pagdurusa, karamdaman, digmaan, at kalungkutan sa mundo ngayon? Kasalanan ba ito ng Diyos?
Tagalog.answer: Nilikha ng Diyos sina Adan at Eva na perpekto, malusog, at masaya, at may kakayahang pumili sa pagitan ng pagsunod at pagsuway sa Diyos—gaya ng pagpiling hinaharap natin araw-araw. Kapag pumipili tayo, kailangan din nating tanggapin ang kahihinatnan. Nang piliin nina Adan at Eva ang pagsuway, pumasok sa mundo ang kasalanan, sakit, pagdurusa, at kamatayan. Hindi ito ang buhay na nais ng Diyos para sa sangkatauhan. Basahin ang Roma 5:12.

English.question: What was the name of Adam and Eve’s first two sons and what did they do?
English.answer: Cain was a crop farmer and Abel was a ‘keeper of sheep’.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang pangalan ng unang dalawang anak na lalaki nina Adan at Eva, at ano ang kanilang mga gawain?
Tagalog.answer: Si Cain ay magsasaka ng mga pananim, at si Abel ay tagapag-alaga ng mga tupa.

English.question: Why did people in the Old Testament bring blood sacrifices to God?
English.answer: A sacrifice to GOD had a very specific purpose. The innocent lamb was a symbol of Christ Who would sacrifice His innocent and sinless life to pay the penalty for the sins of fallen humanity. The blood of the lamb represented Christ’s blood that washes away our sin. This is why people in the Old Testament brought blood sacrifices to the Lord. In this way they showed that they understood how sin leads to death and that an innocent Lamb (Jesus Christ) would one day give the perfect sacrifice on behalf of all mankind. Read Heb 9:22.

Tagalog.question: Bakit nag-aalay ng mga haing may dugo sa Diyos ang mga tao sa Lumang Tipan?
Tagalog.answer: May partikular na layunin ang paghahain sa DIYOS. Ang inosenteng kordero ay sumasagisag kay Cristo, na maghahain ng Kaniyang walang-sala at banal na buhay upang bayaran ang parusa sa kasalanan ng nahulog na sangkatauhan. Ang dugo ng kordero ay kumakatawan sa dugo ni Cristo na naghuhugas ng ating kasalanan. Kaya naghahandog ng mga haing may dugo ang mga tao sa Lumang Tipan. Sa ganitong paraan, ipinakikita nilang nauunawaan nila na ang kasalanan ay humahantong sa kamatayan at na isang inosenteng Kordero, si Jesu-Cristo, ang maghahain balang-araw ng perpektong sakripisyo para sa buong sangkatauhan. Basahin ang Hebreo 9:22.

English.question: Why did God reject Cain’s sacrifice, yet He accept that of Abel?
English.answer: Because Cain sacrificed the yield of his crop, while Abel sacrificed his best lamb. So Abel brought a blood sacrifice, but Cain did not. Of course Cain could have traded his crop of fruit for one of Abel’s lambs, but he didn’t. The Bible further explains how Abel brought his sacrifice to God in faith because his heart was sincere, but Cain’s heart was not sincere & God knew this.

Tagalog.question: Bakit tinanggihan ng Diyos ang handog ni Cain ngunit tinanggap ang kay Abel?
Tagalog.answer: Naghandog si Cain ng bunga ng kaniyang pananim, samantalang ang pinakamainam na kordero ang inialay ni Abel. Kaya nagdala si Abel ng haing may dugo, ngunit hindi si Cain. Maaari sanang ipagpalit ni Cain ang kaniyang ani para sa isang kordero ni Abel, ngunit hindi niya ginawa. Ipinapaliwanag din ng Biblia na naghandog si Abel nang may pananampalataya at tapat na puso, samantalang hindi tapat ang puso ni Cain, at alam iyon ng Diyos.

English.question: How did Cain react when God rejected his sacrifice?
English.answer: Cain became very upset and angry

Tagalog.question: Ano ang naging reaksiyon ni Cain nang tanggihan ng Diyos ang kaniyang handog?
Tagalog.answer: Labis siyang nalungkot at nagalit.

English.question: How did God try and help Cain to turn away from sin and did Cain listen?
English.answer: Read Gen 4:6-7. No, he did not listen, he ignored it and consequently, he just became angrier and angrier.

Tagalog.question: Paano tinulungan ng Diyos si Cain na talikuran ang kasalanan? Nakinig ba siya?
Tagalog.answer: Basahin ang Genesis 4:6–7. Hindi siya nakinig. Binale-wala niya ang babala at lalo lamang siyang nagalit.

English.question: What did all this pent-up anger of Cain eventually lead to?
English.answer: One day, when Cain and Abel were alone in the field, Cain’s pent-up anger suddenly boiled over and the next moment he struck Abel, his own brother, and killed him! This was the very first murder ever on earth.

Tagalog.question: Saan humantong ang kinimkim na galit ni Cain?
Tagalog.answer: Isang araw, nang silang dalawa ni Abel lamang ang nasa bukid, biglang sumiklab ang kinimkim na galit ni Cain. Sinaktan niya ang kaniyang sariling kapatid at pinatay ito! Ito ang kauna-unahang pagpatay sa tao sa Daigdig.

English.question: What very important lesson do we learn from this?
English.answer: We learn that we should not give free reign to our emotions — it can destroy us and those around us. We have to pray daily and ask God to help us to remain in control of our emotions. Our emotions (especially anger) should not control us, but rather, we should remain in control of our emotions. Fact is, when we are angry, we cannot think clearly and we sometimes do very dumb things…

Tagalog.question: Anong napakahalagang aral ang natututuhan natin dito?
Tagalog.answer: Hindi natin dapat hayaang mamahala nang lubos ang ating mga damdamin, sapagkat maaari nitong sirain tayo at ang mga nasa paligid natin. Dapat tayong manalangin araw-araw at humingi ng tulong sa Diyos upang makontrol natin ang ating damdamin. Hindi tayo dapat kontrolin ng ating emosyon, lalo na ng galit. Kapag galit tayo, hindi tayo nakapag-iisip nang malinaw at kung minsan ay gumagawa ng mga hindi matalinong bagay.

English.question: Do we still have a sacrificial system today where we need to bring sacrifices?
English.answer: No, the entire system came to an end after Jesus, the perfect Lamb of God, brought the perfect sacrifice. That single and perfect sacrifice that replaced the old testament blood sacrifices, was the crucifixion of Jesus Christ. This is why God no longer wants us to bring any other blood- sacrifices. Read Heb 10:10.

Tagalog.question: May sistema pa ba tayo ngayon ng mga paghahain na kailangang dalhin sa Diyos?
Tagalog.answer: Wala na. Natapos ang buong sistema nang ihain ni Jesus, ang perpektong Kordero ng Diyos, ang ganap na sakripisyo. Ang iisang sakripisyong pumalit sa mga handog na may dugo sa Lumang Tipan ay ang pagpapako kay Jesu-Cristo sa krus. Kaya hindi na nais ng Diyos na magdala tayo ng ibang mga haing may dugo. Basahin ang Hebreo 10:10.

English.question: What was the name of the first son that Adam and Eve had after Abel’s death and what does his name mean?
English.answer: Seth and that means ‘substitute’

Tagalog.question: Ano ang pangalan ng unang anak nina Adan at Eva pagkatapos mamatay si Abel, at ano ang ibig sabihin ng pangalan niya?
Tagalog.answer: Si Seth, na ang ibig sabihin ay “kapalit.”

English.question: Who was Cain’s wife?
English.answer: In Genesis 5:4 we learn that Adam and Eve had other sons...ssss and other daughters...sss. Adam lived for a whopping 930 years. That would have been ample time to build quite a substantial nation. Since Adam and Eve were the first and only people on earth and since they had many children, Cain and Seth and their other brothers must have married their own sisters!

Tagalog.question: Sino ang asawa ni Cain?
Tagalog.answer: Sa Genesis 5:4, nalalaman nating nagkaroon pa sina Adan at Eva ng ibang mga anak na lalaki at babae. Umabot sa 930 taon ang buhay ni Adan, sapat upang magkaroon ng napakalaking pamilya o bayan. Dahil sina Adan at Eva ang mga unang tao sa lupa at marami silang anak, ayon sa materyal ay maaaring napangasawa nina Cain, Seth, at ng kanilang mga kapatid na lalaki ang sarili nilang mga kapatid na babae.

English.question: What are mutations?
English.answer: Your body is composed of billions of tiny little cells, and inside each tiny little cell, we have even tinier things called ‘genes’. These genes carry all the information that we inherited from our parents and which we will one day carry over to our own children. As these genes are carried over from one generation to the next, mistakes sometimes slip in. We call these mistakes, ‘mutations’ and mutations are responsible for hundreds of hereditary diseases such as cancer and various birth defects. Over the years, these mutations have increased in each new generation. Different families have different mutations. So two people who come from different families, usually carry different mutations (mutant genes) and when they get married and have children, the ‘good’ genes (or the genes that are not mutated) will be ‘in charge’ in their children. So their children should not have any defects or diseases caused by mutations. However, when a brother and sister get married and have children, the chances of defects and mutation diseases in their children are much higher because a brother and a sister come from the same family and therefore have a greater chance of bearing the same harmful mutations in their genes.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang mga mutasyon (mutations)?
Tagalog.answer: Binubuo ang iyong katawan ng bilyun-bilyong maliliit na selula. Sa bawat selula ay may mas maliliit na bahaging tinatawag na “genes.” Ang mga gene ay nagdadala ng impormasyong namana natin sa ating mga magulang at maipapasa natin balang-araw sa ating mga anak. Kapag naipapasa ang mga gene mula sa isang henerasyon patungo sa susunod, kung minsan ay may mga pagkakamaling nagaganap. Tinatawag itong “mutasyon.” Ayon sa aralin, kaugnay ng mga mutasyon ang maraming namamanang karamdaman at depekto sa kapanganakan, kabilang ang ilang uri ng kanser. Sinasabi rin nitong dumarami ang mga mutasyon sa mga sumunod na henerasyon. Magkakaiba ang mga mutasyon sa bawat pamilya, kaya kapag ang dalawang taong mula sa magkaibang pamilya ay nagkaanak, maaaring manaig ang mga gene na walang mapaminsalang mutasyon. Subalit kung magkapatid ang nagkaanak, mas mataas ang panganib ng mga depekto o sakit na nauugnay sa mutasyon dahil mas malaki ang posibilidad na taglay nilang pareho ang parehong mapaminsalang gene.

English.question: Isn’t it wrong for a brother to marry his sister?
English.answer: In the beginning, mutations was not a problem. They didn’t even exist because Adam and Eve were created perfect. But because of the Fall, everything was affected negatively — even those tiny particles that we call ‘genes’. Initially, the appearance of genetic mutations were still very low and that is why there were no genetic problems when Adam and Eve’s children married one other and had children. It took many hundreds of years for mutations to increase to such an extent that it became dangerous for a brother to marry his sister. This is why, in the time of Moses (about 2,500 years later), GOD gave specific instructions on this. Read this in Lev 18:9 and Deut 27:22. This explains why it was acceptable for brothers and sisters to marry one another in the beginning, but not anymore today.

Tagalog.question: Hindi ba mali para sa isang lalaki na pakasalan ang kaniyang kapatid na babae?
Tagalog.answer: Ayon sa aralin, noong pasimula ay hindi pa problema ang mga mutasyon dahil nilikha sina Adan at Eva na perpekto. Ngunit dahil sa Pagkahulog, naapektuhan nang masama ang lahat, maging ang mga gene. Sa unang panahon ay napakakaunti pa raw ng mga mutasyon kaya walang problemang genetiko nang mag-asawa ang mga anak nina Adan at Eva sa isa't isa. Maraming daang taon pa ang lumipas bago dumami ang mga mutasyon hanggang sa maging mapanganib ang pag-aasawa ng magkapatid. Kaya sa panahon ni Moises, mga 2,500 taon pagkatapos, nagbigay ang DIYOS ng mga tiyak na tagubilin tungkol dito. Basahin ang Levitico 18:9 at Deuteronomio 27:22. Ipinaliliwanag nito kung bakit, ayon sa materyal, pinahihintulutan ito noong pasimula ngunit hindi na ngayon.

English.question: What about cousins — can they get married and have children?
English.answer: When first cousins marry and have children, the chances of them carrying a disease forming mutation to their children, is one in eight! That is a very high chance!

Tagalog.question: Paano naman ang magpinsan? Maaari ba silang mag-asawa at magkaanak?
Tagalog.answer: Sinasabi ng aralin na kapag nagkaanak ang magpinsang buo, ang posibilidad ng pagpasa ng isang mutasyong nagdudulot ng sakit ay isa sa walo. Napakataas daw ng posibilidad na iyon!

English.question: Which animals did God say Noah had to take on the Ark?
English.answer: One pair of each kind of land animal as well as one pair of each kind of flying animal. He also took seven pairs of all kinds of clean animals onboard.

Tagalog.question: Aling mga hayop ang sinabi ng Diyos na dapat isakay ni Noe sa arka?
Tagalog.answer: Isang pares ng bawat uri ng hayop sa lupa at isang pares ng bawat uri ng nilalang na lumilipad. Nagsakay rin siya ng pitong pares ng bawat uri ng malinis na hayop.

English.question: What is a ‘clean’ animal?
English.answer: These animals are acceptable for humans to eat, while the ‘unclean’ animals are not. Read about this in Lev 11. Only clean animals were used in sacrifices to God, which is why God told Noah to take 7 extra pairs of ‘clean’ animals onboard as well.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang “malinis” na hayop?
Tagalog.answer: Ito ang mga hayop na pinahihintulutang kainin ng tao, samantalang hindi maaaring kainin ang mga “maruming” hayop. Basahin ang Levitico 11. Mga malinis na hayop lamang ang ginagamit sa mga hain sa Diyos, kaya sinabi ng Diyos kay Noe na magsakay rin ng pitong karagdagang pares ng mga malinis na hayop.

English.question: How big was the ark?
English.answer: The Ark was 140m long (longer than a soccer field), 23m wide (as wide as four traffic lanes) and 14m high (higher than a four-story building) and it had three decks.

Tagalog.question: Gaano kalaki ang arka?
Tagalog.answer: Ang arka ay 140 metro ang haba (mas mahaba kaysa sa isang soccer field), 23 metro ang lapad (kasukat ng apat na linya ng kalsada), at 14 metro ang taas (mas mataas kaysa sa apat na palapag na gusali). May tatlong palapag ito.

English.question: Was the ark stable enough to handle rough seas?
English.answer: Oh yes! Korean shipbuilders found the Ark, as described in the Bible, to be one of the most stable forms of seafaring vehicles able to handle a very rough sea. According to them, the Ark could withstand winds of up to three-times hurricane-strength and waves up to 30m high (and probably even higher) and it could tilt over beyond 60 degrees without toppling over.

Tagalog.question: Sapat ba ang katatagan ng arka upang makayanan ang maalon na dagat?
Tagalog.answer: Oo! Ayon sa materyal, natuklasan ng mga tagagawa ng barko sa Korea na ang anyo ng arka na inilalarawan sa Biblia ay isa sa pinakamatatag na sasakyang pandagat para sa napakaalon na karagatan. Sinabi nilang kaya nitong harapin ang hanging hanggang tatlong beses ang lakas ng bagyo at mga along hanggang 30 metro ang taas, marahil ay mas mataas pa. Maaari rin umano itong tumagilid nang higit sa 60 digri nang hindi tumaob.

English.question: Do you think that Noah built the ark all by himself?
English.answer: No, his sons also helped and it’s very likely that Noah hired laborers to help them.

Tagalog.question: Sa palagay mo ba ay mag-isang itinayo ni Noe ang arka?
Tagalog.answer: Hindi. Tumulong din ang kaniyang mga anak na lalaki at malamang na kumuha si Noe ng mga manggagawa upang tumulong sa kanila.

English.question: How much time had lapsed since the time that God issued the warning that He was going to destroy the earth with a Flood; and why so long?
English.answer: 120 Years. This was a period of grace during which they could repent and turn to God. During this time, Noah built the Ark and continually warned the people: ‘Repent, for a Flood is coming’.

Tagalog.question: Gaano katagal mula nang magbigay ang Diyos ng babala na gugunawin Niya ang lupa sa pamamagitan ng Baha, at bakit napakatagal?
Tagalog.answer: 120 taon. Panahon ito ng biyaya kung kailan maaari pang magsisi at magbalik-loob sa Diyos ang mga tao. Sa panahong iyon, itinayo ni Noe ang arka at patuloy na nagbabala sa mga tao: “Magsisi kayo, sapagkat darating ang Baha.”

English.question: What did the people have to do to be saved?
English.answer: They simply had to believe and trust in God by getting into the Ark when the time came.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang kailangang gawin ng mga tao upang maligtas?
Tagalog.answer: Kailangan lamang nilang maniwala at magtiwala sa Diyos sa pamamagitan ng pagpasok sa arka pagdating ng takdang panahon.

English.question: Did they listen? What was their reaction?
English.answer: No, they mocked Noah, and laughed at him.

Tagalog.question: Nakinig ba sila? Ano ang naging reaksiyon nila?
Tagalog.answer: Hindi. Kinutya nila si Noe at pinagtawanan siya.

English.question: What did Jesus later have to say about this and how is this being repeated today?
English.answer: Read Matt 24:38-39 first. Jesus has given us His assurance that He is coming to the earth again, this time He will come as The Judge. But just as in the time of Noah, many people simply don’t believe that this will happen and therefore, they will also be caught off guard.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang sinabi ni Jesus kalaunan tungkol dito, at paano ito nauulit ngayon?
Tagalog.answer: Basahin muna ang Mateo 24:38–39. Tiniyak sa atin ni Jesus na muli Siyang darating sa Daigdig, at sa pagkakataong iyon ay darating Siya bilang Hukom. Ngunit tulad noong panahon ni Noe, maraming tao ang hindi naniniwalang mangyayari ito kaya maaabutan din silang hindi handa.

English.question: Did Noah have to gather all the animals by himself?
English.answer: No, Noah could have used hired help or his own servants to gather the animals, just like the emperors did centuries later. Also, the Bible says that God instructed the animals to go into the Ark, so Noah did not have to chase the animals to gather them.

Tagalog.question: Kinailangan bang tipunin ni Noe ang lahat ng hayop nang mag-isa?
Tagalog.answer: Hindi. Maaaring gumamit si Noe ng mga bayarang manggagawa o mga lingkod upang tipunin ang mga hayop, gaya ng ginawa ng mga emperador pagkalipas ng maraming siglo. Sinasabi rin ng Biblia na inutusan ng Diyos ang mga hayop na pumasok sa arka, kaya hindi kinailangang habulin ni Noe ang mga ito.

English.question: Where was Noah according to Gen 6:20 and 7:15 and what else do we learn here?
English.answer: He was inside the Ark. We learn that God was completely in control of how the animals were selected and gathered for the Ark. Noah may even have built up an animal collection before the Flood began and then God supernaturally commandeered the animals into the Ark.

Tagalog.question: Nasaan si Noe ayon sa Genesis 6:20 at 7:15, at ano pa ang natututuhan natin dito?
Tagalog.answer: Nasa loob siya ng arka. Natututuhan natin na lubos na namahala ang Diyos sa pagpili at pagtitipon ng mga hayop para sa arka. Maaaring nagtayo pa si Noe ng isang koleksiyon ng mga hayop bago ang Baha, at pagkatapos ay mahimalang pinapasok ng Diyos ang mga ito sa arka.

English.question: What advantages could there be to build up an animal collection before the Flood?
English.answer: Animals in captivity are more used to people and are therefore easier to handle. Noah could have observed the animals carefully to identify any weak or diseased animals and replace them with healthy, strong ones to take on the ark.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang maaaring mga pakinabang ng pagtitipon ng mga hayop bago dumating ang Baha?
Tagalog.answer: Mas sanay sa tao ang mga hayop na nasa pangangalaga ng tao, kaya mas madaling hawakan ang mga ito. Maaari ring maingat na suriin ni Noe ang mga hayop upang matukoy ang mahina o may sakit at palitan sila ng malulusog at malalakas na hayop na isasakay sa arka.

English.question: Read Gen 7:22. Were there insects on the ark?
English.answer: Possibly, but Noah did not have to specifically gather them since insects don’t breathe through nostrils.

Tagalog.question: Basahin ang Genesis 7:22. May mga insekto ba sa arka?
Tagalog.answer: Maaaring mayroon, ngunit hindi kinailangang sadyang tipunin ni Noe ang mga ito dahil hindi humihinga ang mga insekto sa pamamagitan ng butas ng ilong.

English.question: What does it mean when it says that only the ‘original kinds’ were on the ark?
English.answer: Read page 72-75 in Creation to re-creation or refer to the presentation. The Biblical record (the lists of animals in Leviticus) indicates that the original created kinds were not on the ‘species’ level of today’s classification, but probably on the ‘family’ level, such as the cat family, the elephant family, the dog/wolf family, etc.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng pagsasabing ang “mga orihinal na uri” lamang ang nasa arka?
Tagalog.answer: Basahin ang pahina 72–75 ng Creation to Re-creation o tingnan ang presentasyon. Ayon sa aralin, ipinahihiwatig ng mga listahan ng hayop sa Biblia, lalo na sa Levitico, na ang orihinal na mga nilikhang uri ay hindi tumutugma sa “species” sa makabagong klasipikasyon, kundi marahil ay nasa antas ng “pamilya,” gaya ng pamilya ng pusa, elepante, at aso/lobo.

English.question: What do we call a cross-breed between a horse and a donkey?
English.answer: A mule

Tagalog.question: Ano ang tawag sa anak ng kabayo at asno?
Tagalog.answer: Mule o mola.

English.question: What do we call a cross-breed between a zebra and a donkey?
English.answer: A zonkey

Tagalog.question: Ano ang tawag sa anak ng zebra at asno?
Tagalog.answer: Zonkey.

English.question: A lion and a tiger? A whale and a dolphin?
English.answer: A liger and a wholphin

Tagalog.question: Paano naman ang leon at tigre? Ang balyena at dolphin?
Tagalog.answer: Liger at wholphin.

English.question: What do we learn from this?
English.answer: Ligers prove that lions and tigers are different species, but the same kind. Wholpins prove that whales and dolphins are different species, but the same kind. All of these cross-breeds prove that they originated from a specific originally created kind respectively.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang natututuhan natin dito?
Tagalog.answer: Sinasabi ng materyal na ipinakikita ng mga liger na magkaibang species ang mga leon at tigre ngunit iisang “uri,” at gayundin ang mga wholphin para sa mga balyena at dolphin. Para sa aralin, ipinakikita ng mga ganitong anak ng magkaibang lahi na nagmula sila sa kani-kanilang partikular na orihinal na nilikhang uri.

English.question: Were there poodles and doberman pinchers onboard?
English.answer: No, because they did not exist yet. Only the original dog/wolf kind was onboard from which the foxes, wolves, jackal, wolves and various dog-breeds later originated

Tagalog.question: May mga poodle at Doberman Pinscher ba sa arka?
Tagalog.answer: Wala, sapagkat hindi pa umiiral ang mga iyon. Ayon sa aralin, ang orihinal na uri ng aso/lobo lamang ang nasa arka, na pinagmulan ng mga soro, lobo, asong-gubat, at iba't ibang lahi ng aso.

English.question: Were there dinosaurs onboard and why do you say so?
English.answer: Yes, because dinosaurs were a land animal kind that breathed air through nostrils and that was created by God together with all the other land animals on Day 6. God told Noah to take one pair of each land animal kind into the Ark. This therefore included dinosaurs.

Tagalog.question: May mga dinosaur ba sa arka, at bakit mo nasabi iyon?
Tagalog.answer: Oo, ayon sa aralin, sapagkat ang mga dinosaur ay mga hayop sa lupa na humihinga sa pamamagitan ng butas ng ilong at nilikha ng Diyos kasama ng iba pang mga hayop sa lupa noong ikaanim na araw. Sinabi ng Diyos kay Noe na isakay ang isang pares ng bawat uri ng hayop sa lupa, kaya kasama rin daw rito ang mga dinosaur.

English.question: How on earth did dinosaurs fit into the ark?
English.answer: Most dinosaurs weren’t that big at all; some were even smaller than chickens! The average size of an adult dinosaur was approximately that of a sheep! (some say a bison). The largest egg ever hatched by a dinosaur was only about the size of a football, which means that even the biggest dinosaurs such as the Apatosaurus and Brachiosaurus used to be quite small, just like you and me!

Tagalog.question: Paano nagkasya sa arka ang mga dinosaur?
Tagalog.answer: Ayon sa materyal, hindi naman napakalaki ng karamihan sa mga dinosaur at ang ilan ay mas maliit pa sa manok! Sinasabi rin nitong ang karaniwang laki ng adultong dinosaur ay halos kasinlaki ng tupa (o bison ayon sa iba). Ang pinakamalaking itlog ng dinosaur ay halos kasinlaki lamang ng bola sa football, kaya kahit ang malalaking uri tulad ng Apatosaurus at Brachiosaurus ay dating maliliit din, gaya natin noong tayo'y sanggol.

English.question: What advantages were there in taking young animals onboard?
English.answer: Younger animals are smaller and therefore could have easily fitted into the Ark. They would have been easier to feed and they would have had babies sooner after the Flood.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang mga pakinabang ng pagsakay ng mga batang hayop sa arka?
Tagalog.answer: Mas maliliit ang mga batang hayop kaya mas madaling magkakasya sa arka. Mas madali rin silang pakainin at mas maaga silang magkakaanak pagkatapos ng Baha.

English.question: How many animals were probably on the ark?
English.answer: Only about 2,000 animals (1,000 pairs) if we use the family level of classification. If we use the generic level of classification, if would be about 16,000 animals (8,000 pairs).

Tagalog.question: Humigit-kumulang ilang hayop ang maaaring nasa arka?
Tagalog.answer: Mga 2,000 hayop lamang (1,000 pares) kung gagamitin ang antas ng pamilya sa klasipikasyon. Kung gagamitin naman ang antas na genus, sinasabi ng materyal na maaaring mga 16,000 hayop (8,000 pares).

English.question: How much space would they have needed on the ark?
English.answer: Only about 3%

Tagalog.question: Gaano kalaking espasyo ang kailangan ng mga hayop sa arka?
Tagalog.answer: Mga 3% lamang.

English.question: What about food — how much space would it have occupied on the ark?
English.answer: Read pages 79-81 Creation to re-creation. It would have occupied about 15% of the ark’s space.

Tagalog.question: Paano naman ang pagkain? Gaano kalaking espasyo ang sakop nito sa arka?
Tagalog.answer: Basahin ang pahina 79–81 ng Creation to Re-creation. Ayon sa materyal, mga 15% ng espasyo sa arka ang kakailanganin para sa pagkain.

English.question: What about water?
English.answer: If they took water onboard as well, the water would probably have occupied about 10% of the space on the Ark. But there’s a large possibility that they may have simply used some of the enormous amounts of rainwater, rather than storing it inside the Ark. Then there would have been even more open space.

Tagalog.question: Paano naman ang tubig?
Tagalog.answer: Kung nagdala sila ng tubig, maaaring sumakop ito ng mga 10% ng espasyo sa arka. Ngunit posible ring ginamit nila ang napakaraming tubig-ulan sa halip na mag-imbak sa loob ng arka. Kung gayon, lalo pang lumaki ang bakanteng espasyo.

English.question: What does this all mean?
English.answer: This means that more than 72% of the Ark and possibly even more, was open space! So there was more than enough space for Noah, his family, all the animals and even the food and water.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng lahat ng ito?
Tagalog.answer: Ibig sabihin, higit sa 72% ng arka, at marahil ay mas marami pa, ang bakanteng espasyo! Kaya higit sa sapat ang lugar para kay Noe, sa kaniyang pamilya, sa lahat ng hayop, at maging sa pagkain at tubig.

English.question: Who was the open space for?
English.answer: For all the unbelievers that refused to heed God’s warning.

Tagalog.question: Para kanino ang bakanteng espasyong iyon?
Tagalog.answer: Para sa mga hindi nanampalataya at tumangging makinig sa babala ng Diyos.

English.question: Were the people in Biblical times less clever than we are?
English.answer: The idea that people of ancient times were less intelligent than we are, is just another evolutionary idea. In Gen 4 it says that Adam and his descendants were grain and livestock farmers. They made musical instruments, could forge metal and built cities. Shortly after the Flood, the Egyptians learnt how to write, how to cut granite and how to build the pyramids with great precision, intricate design and fine detail — all without computers. Adam and Eve were created perfect, but since the fall, the mental ability of humans began to decline over a period of 6,000 years. We are, in all probability far less intelligent than they were.

Tagalog.question: Hindi ba kasingtalino natin ang mga tao noong panahon ng Biblia?
Tagalog.answer: Ayon sa aralin, ang ideyang mas mababa ang talino ng mga tao noong unang panahon ay isa pang ideyang may kaugnayan sa ebolusyon. Sinasabi sa Genesis 4 na si Adan at ang mga inapo niya ay nagsasaka ng butil at nag-aalaga ng hayop. Gumagawa sila ng mga instrumentong pangmusika, nakapagpoproseso ng metal, at nagtatayo ng mga lungsod. Hindi nagtagal pagkatapos ng Baha, natutuhan ng mga Ehipsiyo ang pagsulat, pagputol ng granite, at paggawa ng mga pyramid na may kahanga-hangang katumpakan at masalimuot na disenyo—kahit walang computer. Sinasabi ng materyal na perpekto ang pagkakalikha kina Adan at Eva, ngunit unti-unting bumaba ang kakayahang pangkaisipan ng tao sa loob ng 6,000 taon mula sa Pagkahulog. Kaya maaaring mas mababa pa raw ang ating talino kaysa sa kanila.

English.question: How long were they on the ark
English.answer: One year and eleven days

Tagalog.question: Gaano katagal sila nanatili sa arka?
Tagalog.answer: Isang taon at labing-isang araw.

English.question: How can we learn more about the Flood?
English.answer: None of us were there, which is why we can only draw conclusions regarding the circumstances surrounding the Flood by looking at fossils and landscapes and by comparing it with what has been revealed in the Bible. The Bible is filled with details about the Flood. In fact, the Flood represents the most detailed account of any single event in the Bible. There is also clear evidence in nature that testifies to the consequences of the Flood.

Tagalog.question: Paano tayo maaaring matuto pa tungkol sa Baha?
Tagalog.answer: Wala sa atin ang naroon noong Baha. Kaya makabubuo lamang tayo ng mga konklusyon tungkol sa mga pangyayari sa pamamagitan ng pagsusuri sa mga fossil at anyong lupa at paghahambing ng mga ito sa ipinahayag sa Biblia. Maraming detalye sa Biblia tungkol sa Baha. Sa katunayan, isa ito sa mga pangyayaring may pinakadetalyadong salaysay sa Biblia. Ayon sa materyal, mayroon ding malinaw na mga tanda sa kalikasan ng mga naging epekto ng Baha.

English.question: More or less how long ago did the Flood occur?
English.answer: Approximately 2,500bC, so that’s about 4,500 years ago

Tagalog.question: Humigit-kumulang kailan naganap ang Baha?
Tagalog.answer: Mga 2,500 BC, o humigit-kumulang 4,500 taon na ang nakalipas.

English.question: What do we learn about the climate before the Flood?
English.answer: It appears that the climate before the Flood was nice and warm, all the way from the North Pole to the South Pole, mainly because deserts, glaciers, ice caps and higher sea levels probably did not exist before the Flood. This means that more ground surface was available for the growth of a much larger number of plants than today. The higher number of plants on earth before the Flood would have caused higher levels of CO2 to be produced. This would have resulted in warmer temperatures, because the greenhouse-effect of CO2 prevents warm air from leaving the earth. Various plant fossils have been discovered all around the world, even under Antarctica’s ice caps where coal seams have been discovered. Coal is actually plant material that fossilized and these coal seams contain plants which do not occur in the Polar Regions today, but only in warmer parts. In other words, these plant fossils indicate that the earth was nice and warm before the Flood, even in what we know today to be the Polar regions

Tagalog.question: Ano ang natututuhan natin tungkol sa klima bago ang Baha?
Tagalog.answer: Ayon sa materyal, tila mainit at kaaya-aya ang klima bago ang Baha, mula Hilagang Polo hanggang Timog Polo, sapagkat maaaring wala pa noon ang mga disyerto, glacier, takip-yelo, at mas mataas na antas ng dagat. Ibig sabihin, mas malawak ang lupang mapagtutubuan ng napakaraming halaman kaysa ngayon. Dahil sa mas maraming halaman bago ang Baha, sinasabi nitong mas mataas ang antas ng CO2 na nagdudulot ng mas mainit na temperatura dahil sa greenhouse effect. May natagpuang mga fossil ng halaman sa buong mundo, kahit sa ilalim ng takip-yelo sa Antarctica kung saan natagpuan ang mga patong ng karbon. Ang karbon ay materyal na nagmula sa halaman at naging fossil. Naglalaman ang mga patong na iyon ng mga halamang hindi tumutubo sa mga rehiyong polar ngayon kundi sa mas maiinit na lugar. Kaya, ayon sa aralin, ipinahihiwatig ng mga fossil na mainit din noon ang mga rehiyong polar.

English.question: But isn’t CO2 bad for our planet today?
English.answer: No! Higher CO2 levels will actually improve plant growth and productivity! It is the other emissions such as sulfur dioxide and soot that are undesirable and that should be reduced, but CO2 is a God-designed colorless, odorless gas, and a crucial part in the cycle of life.

Tagalog.question: Ngunit hindi ba masama ang CO2 para sa ating planeta ngayon?
Tagalog.answer: Hindi, ayon sa materyal. Sinasabi nitong nakapagpapabuti sa paglaki at produksiyon ng halaman ang mas mataas na CO2. Ang iba pang emisyon tulad ng sulfur dioxide at uling ang hindi kanais-nais at dapat bawasan. Ang CO2 ay inilalarawan nitong walang kulay at amoy na gas na dinisenyo ng Diyos at mahalagang bahagi ng siklo ng buhay.

English.question: Was the ocean as deep before the Flood as it is today?
English.answer: Very likely, only broad rivers and a shallow sea existed. Before the Flood, most of the water was probably located deep in the earth’s mantle where there is still a lot of water present today.

Tagalog.question: Kasinglalim ba ng mga karagatan ngayon ang dagat bago ang Baha?
Tagalog.answer: Ayon sa materyal, malamang na malalawak na ilog at mababaw na dagat lamang ang mayroon noon. Bago ang Baha, maaaring ang karamihan sa tubig ay nasa malalim na mantle ng Daigdig, kung saan marami pa ring tubig ngayon.

English.question: Did the Flood really cover the entire earth? Wasn’t it simply a local flood in a smaller,
English.answer: local area, where Noah once lived (Mesopotamia)? If it was only a local Flood, GOD could have simply told Noah to move away, maybe to the top of a high mountain. He would not have had to take flying animals because they could have simply flown away. Most importantly: Although God promised that there would never again be another worldwide Flood. As a sign of this promise, HE gave us the rainbow. Through the years, many local floods have occurred in various places on earth, but there has never, ever been another worldwide Flood such as the one in Noah’s day. In other words, if Noah’s Flood was only a local flood, it would mean that God has broken His promise over and over and over again, because there has been countless local floods on earth since Noah’s time. God NEVER breaks His promises!

Tagalog.question: Talaga bang tinakpan ng Baha ang buong Daigdig? Hindi ba maaaring isang lokal na baha lamang sa Mesopotamia, kung saan nakatira noon si Noe?
Tagalog.answer: Kung lokal na baha lamang iyon, maaari na sanang utusan ng DIYOS si Noe na lumipat sa ibang lugar o umakyat sa mataas na bundok. Hindi na rin sana niya kailangang isakay ang mga nilalang na lumilipad dahil makalilipad naman ang mga iyon palayo. Higit sa lahat, nangako ang Diyos na hindi na muling magkakaroon ng isang baha na tatakip sa buong Daigdig, at ibinigay Niya ang bahaghari bilang tanda ng pangakong ito. Mula noon ay nagkaroon na ng maraming lokal na baha ngunit wala nang pangyayaring katulad ng Baha noong panahon ni Noe. Kung lokal na baha lamang ang nangyari noon, mangangahulugan daw na paulit-ulit nang sinira ng Diyos ang Kaniyang pangako dahil sa napakaraming lokal na bahang naganap pagkatapos. HINDI kailanman sinisira ng Diyos ang Kaniyang mga pangako!

English.question: Have a look at the image on page 86 of the book. What interesting calculation did geologists make regarding water in the rocks of the mantel?
English.answer: They have calculated that the rocks in earth’s mantle still contain enough water in their mineral structure to fill up the oceans about 10 times over!

Tagalog.question: Tingnan ang larawan sa pahina 86 ng aklat. Anong kawili-wiling pagkalkula ang ginawa ng mga heologo tungkol sa tubig sa mga bato sa mantle?
Tagalog.answer: Ayon sa materyal, kinalkula nila na ang mga batong nasa mantle ng Daigdig ay naglalaman pa rin ng sapat na tubig sa estrukturang mineral ng mga ito upang mapuno ang mga karagatan nang mga sampung beses!

English.question: Read Gen 7:11. What do we learn here regarding the ‘breaking up of the fountains’?
English.answer: We learn where most of the floodwater probably came from. The ‘breaking up of the fountains’ implies a release of hot magma mixed with steam that pierced the earth’s crust so that giant rifts ran thousands of miles across the planet, tearing open the earth surface. The scolding hot magma that pushed up through these rifts vaporized massive amounts of water into superheated steam that jetted into the atmosphere, then falling back to the earth for 40 days as intense global rain along with torrential rain from heaven as described in the Genesis 7:11.

Tagalog.question: Basahin ang Genesis 7:11. Ano ang natututuhan natin tungkol sa “pagputok ng mga bukal ng kalaliman”?
Tagalog.answer: Ayon sa materyal, ipinahihiwatig nito kung saan maaaring nanggaling ang karamihan sa tubig ng Baha. Ang “pagputok ng mga bukal” ay maaaring tumukoy sa paglabas ng mainit na magma na may kasamang singaw, na bumutas sa balat ng Daigdig at nagbukas ng napakahahabang siwang sa buong planeta. Ang napakainit na magma ay maaaring nagpasingaw ng napakaraming tubig at nagpalipad ng matinding init at singaw sa atmospera, na bumagsak muli bilang malakas na ulan sa loob ng 40 araw, kasabay ng pag-ulang mula sa langit na inilalarawan sa Genesis 7:11.

English.question: Can we still see these rifts today?
English.answer: Yes, we can. They were discovered in the 1950’s and follow a huge circular route across the earth to form the world’s longest mountain range of 74,030 km’s in length. Look at the image on p 85.

Tagalog.question: Nakikita pa rin ba natin ngayon ang mga siwang na iyon?
Tagalog.answer: Oo, ayon sa aralin. Natuklasan ang mga ito noong dekada 1950 at bumubuo raw ng malawak na paikot na hanay sa Daigdig na nagiging pinakamahabang bulubundukin sa mundo, na may habang 74,030 kilometro. Tingnan ang larawan sa pahina 85.

English.question: How did the water overflow the land?
English.answer: The hot magma that pushed up out of the rifts formed a new, hot ocean floor that was so hot that it began to well up, pushing up the ocean water. So the sea level rose dramatically and overflowed the land.

Tagalog.question: Paano umapaw ang tubig sa lupa?
Tagalog.answer: Ayon sa paliwanag, bumuo ang mainit na magmang lumabas sa mga siwang ng panibago at napakainit na sahig ng karagatan. Umalsa ang sahig-dagat dahil sa init, itinulak pataas ang tubig, at biglang tumaas ang antas ng dagat hanggang umapaw ito sa mga lupain.

English.question: Did the continents look the same before the Flood as they do today?
English.answer: No, from the third day of Creation until just before the Flood, earth looked completely different from what it looks like today, probably with one supercontinent. Although we have some idea, no one really knows exactly how the continents fit together in the past, nor do we know how big the super continent really was. Read Gen 1:9-10.

Tagalog.question: Kapareho ba ng hugis ngayon ang mga kontinente bago ang Baha?
Tagalog.answer: Hindi, ayon sa materyal. Mula sa ikatlong araw ng Paglikha hanggang bago ang Baha, ibang-iba ang itsura ng Daigdig at maaaring iisa lamang ang malaking superkontinente. Bagama't may mga ideya tayo, walang nakaaalam ng eksaktong pagkakadugtong noon ng mga kontinente o kung gaano kalaki ang superkontinente. Basahin ang Genesis 1:9–10.

English.question: What is continental drift?
English.answer: The earth’s surface consists of a mosaic of rigid plates, each moving as the other moves. This movement or drifting apart of the continents is called continental drift.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang continental drift?
Tagalog.answer: Binubuo ang ibabaw ng Daigdig ng magkakaugnay na matitigas na tectonic plate na kumikilos nang magkakaugnay. Ang paggalaw o paghihiwalay ng mga kontinente ay tinatawag na continental drift.

English.question: Did the continents really take millions of years to move apart?
English.answer: No. One of the theories on continental drift called Catastrophic plate tectonics by Dr John Baumgardner explains how the speed with which the continents moved apart could have peaked at meters per second rather than millimetres to cm per year (the pace at which plates move today! That’s really fast and this probably happened where certain plates slid/dived beneath other plates (called: ‘subduction’). So the breaking up of the ‘fountains of the deep’ caused the super-continent to be broken up with the plates moving away from each other, sliding/diving under one another and sometimes ramming into each other to form today’s mountain ranges. In this way, the continents moved into their current positions within just a few months.

Tagalog.question: Talaga bang umabot ng milyun-milyong taon ang paghihiwalay ng mga kontinente?
Tagalog.answer: Hindi, ayon sa aralin. Ang isang teoryang tinatawag na Catastrophic Plate Tectonics ni Dr John Baumgardner ay nagmumungkahing maaaring umabot sa ilang metro bawat segundo ang bilis ng paghiwalay ng mga kontinente, sa halip na ilang milimetro o sentimetro bawat taon gaya ng paggalaw ng mga plate ngayon. Maaaring naganap ito kapag lumubog o dumulas ang isang plate sa ilalim ng iba, na tinatawag na “subduction.” Sa paliwanag na ito, ang pagputok ng mga “bukal ng kalaliman” ang naghiwalay sa superkontinente. Lumayo ang mga plate, lumubog sa ilalim ng isa't isa, o nagbanggaan upang mabuo ang mga bulubundukin ngayon. Sa gayong paraan, sinasabi nitong nakarating sa kasalukuyang posisyon ang mga kontinente sa loob lamang ng ilang buwan.

English.question: How long did the fountain continue to squirt water
English.answer: 150 Days or 5 months!

Tagalog.question: Gaano katagal patuloy na bumulwak ang tubig mula sa mga bukal?
Tagalog.answer: 150 araw o limang buwan!

English.question: What else could be indicated by this ‘breaking open of the fountains’?
English.answer: It probably also included a series of volcanic eruptions, especially where the hot new ocean floor began to dive under the continents (called subduction zones). Large amounts of water were released from beneath the surface in the process and violent earthquakes and tsunami’s occurred. Up to 70% of what is released from a volcano is actually water in the form of steam. Violent earthquakes and tsunami’s would have occurred because of this.

Tagalog.question: Ano pa ang maaaring ipinahihiwatig ng “pagputok ng mga bukal”?
Tagalog.answer: Maaaring kasabay nito ang sunod-sunod na pagsabog ng mga bulkan, lalo na sa mga lugar kung saan lumubog ang mainit na bagong sahig-dagat sa ilalim ng mga kontinente o “subduction zones.” Malaking dami ng tubig ang lumabas mula sa ilalim ng lupa at nagkaroon ng malalakas na lindol at tsunami. Ayon sa materyal, hanggang 70% ng inilalabas ng isang bulkan ay maaaring tubig sa anyo ng singaw, na maaaring nakaambag sa mga marahas na lindol at tsunami.

English.question: For how long did the rain continue?
English.answer: 40 Days and nights

Tagalog.question: Gaano katagal ang pag-ulan?
Tagalog.answer: 40 araw at 40 gabi.

English.question: Do you still think that all the water for the Flood came from above?
English.answer: Most of the water most likely came from within the earth and the sea when the ‘fountains of the deep broke open’ and continued to squirt water for 5 months.

Tagalog.question: Sa palagay mo pa ba ay mula lamang sa itaas ang lahat ng tubig ng Baha?
Tagalog.answer: Malamang na nanggaling ang karamihan sa loob ng Daigdig at sa dagat nang “pumutok ang mga bukal ng kalaliman,” na patuloy na bumulwak sa loob ng limang buwan.

English.question: What is a fossil?
English.answer: It is the remains of a once living, ancient organism that is embedded and preserved in rock. It includes plants, animals and their parts (shells, teeth, bones, or complete skeletons), as well as the tracks that they left. Some fossils no longer contain the organism’s original material, but consist of minerals that penetrated the organism to take on its form. These minerals eventually hardened to stone (this is called petrification) and so the minerals are in the exact shape of the organism, or a part of it, but the organism itself is missing.

Tagalog.question: Ano ang fossil?
Tagalog.answer: Ito ang mga labi ng isang dating buhay na sinaunang organismo na nabaon at napanatili sa bato. Kabilang dito ang mga halaman, hayop, at kanilang bahagi—balat-kabibe, ngipin, buto, o buong kalansay—pati ang mga bakas na iniwan nila. Ang ilang fossil ay wala nang orihinal na materyal ng organismo; sa halip, mga mineral ang pumasok at humugis na katulad nito. Sa paglipas ng panahon ay tumigas ang mga mineral at naging bato, na tinatawag na petrification. Kaya nananatili ang hugis ng organismo o ng bahagi nito kahit wala na ang mismong organismo.

English.question: How old are fossils based on Biblical events?
English.answer: Approximately ±4 500 old because they were buried and formed during the Flood.

Tagalog.question: Gaano katanda ang mga fossil batay sa mga pangyayari sa Biblia?
Tagalog.answer: Ayon sa aralin, humigit-kumulang 4,500 taon ang tanda ng mga ito dahil nabaon at nabuo ang mga ito noong Baha.

English.question: How old do most people believe fossils are and why does that not make sense?
English.answer: Most people believe that fossils formed in a slow, gradual process over millions of years during which rock layers or volcanic ash slowly covered the organism. Question: How could this have happened slowly without the organism decaying or being scavenged?

Tagalog.question: Gaano katanda ang iniisip ng karamihan na mga fossil, at bakit itinuturing ng materyal na hindi ito makatuwiran?
Tagalog.answer: Marami ang naniniwalang unti-unting nabuo ang mga fossil sa loob ng milyun-milyong taon habang dahan-dahang natabunan ng patong ng bato o abo ng bulkan ang mga organismo. Itinatanong ng aralin: Paano ito mangyayari nang napakabagal nang hindi muna nabubulok o kinakain ng ibang hayop ang organismo?

English.question: Is their evidence which contradicts the idea of fossils being millions of years old?
English.answer: Researchers have found that chicken bones and wood can be replaced with minerals in just 5-10 years, while a large dinosaur bone might take hundreds of years to completely mineralize. Many dinosaur remains have still not completely turned to stone; sometimes more than half of the fossil is usually still original bone, not stone! Some fossil fish still had a fishy smell when first discovered. Furthermore, there are hundreds of examples of modern objects like cups, keys, scissors, a toy car, etc that was rapidly encapsulated by rock material. Search on www.creation.com for ‘rapid fossils’.

Tagalog.question: May katibayan bang sumasalungat sa ideyang milyun-milyong taon na ang edad ng mga fossil?
Tagalog.answer: Ayon sa materyal, natuklasan ng mga mananaliksik na maaaring mapalitan ng mga mineral ang buto ng manok at kahoy sa loob ng 5–10 taon, samantalang maaaring umabot ng daan-daang taon ang lubusang pagmineralisa ng malaking buto ng dinosaur. Sinasabi rin nitong maraming labi ng dinosaur ang hindi pa ganap na naging bato at kung minsan ay malaking bahagi pa rin nito ang orihinal na buto. May mga fossil na isda ring sinasabing may amoy-isda nang matagpuan. Mayroon ding mga makabagong bagay tulad ng tasa, susi, gunting, at laruang kotse na mabilis na nabalot ng materyang parang bato. Maghanap ng “rapid fossils” sa www.creation.com.

English.question: So fossils can form quickly?
English.answer: Yes! It all depends on the burial conditions.

Tagalog.question: Kaya maaari bang mabilis na mabuo ang mga fossil?
Tagalog.answer: Oo! Nakasalalay ito sa mga kondisyon ng pagkakabaon.

English.question: What are the conditions necessary for a fossil to form?
English.answer: A sudden death, a sudden burial in sediment layers and enormous pressure to lock out the oxygen, because if oxygen had been present, the organism would have rotted before it could have turned into a fossil. The higher the pressure, the faster the sediments encapsulating the organism would have hardened.

Tagalog.question: Anong mga kondisyon ang kinakailangan upang mabuo ang isang fossil?
Tagalog.answer: Ayon sa paliwanag, kailangan ng biglaang pagkamatay, mabilis na pagkakabaon sa mga patong ng sediment, at matinding presyon upang hindi makapasok ang oxygen.
